nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: n8n's native error-workflow mechanism (research.md §4) — fires only when WF-01/02/03 itself crashes (e.g. a genuinely unreachable host), never for a classified failure those workflows already caught and logged themselves via their own /api/internal/* route (analyze, email/send, followups/due all insert their own classified WorkflowEvent before returning). Everything reaching this trigger is therefore always logged as 'unexpected' — if it were a known classification, the originating workflow would have handled it already. Wired to WF-01/02/03 via each workflow's settings.errorWorkflow (set after this workflow is imported and its id is known — see tasks.md T058).

nodes.name: Call /events (log unexpected failure)
nodes.notes: Redaction (FR-041, including nested stack traces) happens server-side in packages/business-rules/src/error-classification.ts before this is ever persisted — this node sends the full error object deliberately, trusting that shared, unit-tested policy rather than re-implementing redaction in a node expression.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ leadId: null, workflowName: $json.workflow.name, executionReference: $json.execution.id, eventType: 'error', status: 'failed', classification: 'unexpected', safeMetadata: { workflowId: $json.workflow.id, executionId: $json.execution.id, lastNodeExecuted: $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted, mode: $json.execution.mode, error: $json.execution.error } }) }}
